title: Polynomial cost bound
statement: For natural numbers $q,C$ with $q>0$, and every natural number $r$, the recursively defined cost satisfies $\mathrm{cost}(q,C,r)\le (C+1+5r)q^r$, where $\mathrm{cost}(q,C,0)=C+1$ and $\mathrm{cost}(q,C,r+1)=q(\mathrm{cost}(q,C,r)+2)+q+2$.
